package llmorgsettings

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"math/rand"
	"net/netip"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func TestGenerateAddressOracle(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("ORACLE_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("ORACLE_OUT unset")
	}
	set := map[netip.Addr]bool{}
	add := func(a netip.Addr) {
		if a.IsValid() {
			set[a] = true
		}
	}
	for _, text := range []string{
		"0.0.0.0", "0.1.2.3", "1.2.3.4", "8.8.8.8", "9.255.255.255", "10.0.0.0", "10.255.255.255", "11.0.0.1", "100.63.255.255", "100.64.0.0",
		"100.127.255.255", "100.128.0.0", "127.0.0.1", "127.255.255.254", "169.253.255.255", "169.254.0.0", "169.254.169.254", "169.255.0.0",
		"172.15.255.255", "172.16.0.0", "172.31.255.255", "172.32.0.0", "192.167.255.255", "192.168.0.0", "192.168.255.255", "192.169.0.0",
		"223.255.255.255", "224.0.0.0", "224.0.0.1", "239.255.255.255", "240.0.0.0", "255.255.255.254", "255.255.255.255",
		"::", "::1", "::2", "::8.8.8.8", "::10.0.0.1", "::a00:1", "::1:a00:1", "::ffff:8.8.8.8", "::ffff:10.0.0.1", "::ffff:127.0.0.1",
		"::ffff:169.254.169.254", "::ffff:100.64.0.1", "::ffff:0.0.0.0", "::ffff:192.88.99.1", "::ffff:255.255.255.255",
		"fe80::1", "fe80::a9fe:a9fe", "febf:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff", "fec0::1", "feff:ffff::1", "fc00::1", "fd12:3456::1",
		"fdff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff", "ff00::", "ff01::1", "ff02::1", "ff05::2", "ffff::1", "100::1", "2606:4700::1111",
		"2001:4860:4860::8888", "2a00:1450::1", "2000::", "2000::1", "3fff::1", "3fff:fff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff", "3fff:1000::1",
		"2001:db8::1", "2001:db8:ffff::1", "2002::1", "2002:808:808::1", "2001::1", "2001:1::1", "2001:1::2", "2001:1::3", "2001:3::1",
		"2001:4:112::1", "2001:2::1", "2001:10::1", "2001:20::1", "2001:30::1", "2001:40::1", "2001:200::1", "2001:1ff::1", "2001:200::",
		"64:ff9b::a00:1", "64:ff9b::808:808", "64:ff9b:1::1", "64:ff9b:1:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff", "64:ff9c::1",
		"4000::1", "8000::1", "c000::1", "e000::1", "f000::1", "f800::1", "fe00::1", "fe7f::1", "1000::1", "200::1", "400::1", "800::1",
		"6000::1", "a000::1",
	} {
		add(netip.MustParseAddr(text))
	}
	edges := func(p netip.Prefix) {
		p = p.Masked()
		first := p.Addr()
		add(first)
		last := first
		bits := first.BitLen()
		raw := first.AsSlice()
		for b := p.Bits(); b < bits; b++ {
			raw[b/8] |= 1 << (7 - uint(b%8))
		}
		last, _ = netip.AddrFromSlice(raw)
		add(last)
		add(first.Prev())
		add(last.Next())
		add(first.Next())
	}
	for _, group := range [][]netip.Prefix{nonGlobalV4, nonGlobalV6, globalExceptionsV6, reservedV6,
		{netip.MustParsePrefix("64:ff9b::/96"), netip.MustParsePrefix("2001:2::/48"), netip.MustParsePrefix("2001:10::/28"), netip.MustParsePrefix("2001:20::/28"),
			netip.MustParsePrefix("2001:db8::/32"), netip.MustParsePrefix("3fff::/20"), netip.MustParsePrefix("100::/64"), netip.MustParsePrefix("2000::/3"),
			netip.MustParsePrefix("10.0.0.0/8"), netip.MustParsePrefix("172.16.0.0/12"), netip.MustParsePrefix("192.168.0.0/16"), netip.MustParsePrefix("169.254.0.0/16"),
			netip.MustParsePrefix("127.0.0.0/8"), netip.MustParsePrefix("224.0.0.0/4"), netip.MustParsePrefix("fc00::/7"), netip.MustParsePrefix("fe80::/10"), netip.MustParsePrefix("ff00::/8")}} {
		for _, p := range group {
			edges(p)
		}
	}
	rng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(20261022))
	for i := 0; i < 400; i++ {
		var b4 [4]byte
		rng.Read(b4[:])
		add(netip.AddrFrom4(b4))
	}
	for i := 0; i < 400; i++ {
		var b16 [16]byte
		rng.Read(b16[:])
		if i%2 == 0 {
			b16[0] = 0x20 | (b16[0] & 0x1f)
		}
		add(netip.AddrFrom16(b16))
	}
	addrs := make([]netip.Addr, 0, len(set))
	for a := range set {
		addrs = append(addrs, a)
	}
	sort.Slice(addrs, func(i, j int) bool { return addrs[i].Compare(addrs[j]) < 0 })
	rows := make([][2]any, 0, len(addrs))
	for _, a := range addrs {
		rows = append(rows, [2]any{a.String(), isSafePublicIP(a)})
	}
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"rows": rows}, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(raw, '\n'), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("rows=%d", len(rows))
}
